# The marker under your controlled player: a flat ring 0.5 m in radius, 0.1 m wide.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Mark --base-color 1.000 0.855 0.439 --no-slot
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-segments 16 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.5 --minor-radius 0.07 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.3
apply --scale
material assign Mark
shade flat
export ring.glb
